content:
**Parent line value region (#1029)**

A prose Parent: key declares the reference it names plus a joined list; the rest of the line is prose. The old rule counted every #N to end of line, so issue #998's opening sentence read as five competing parents and the base-branch gate refused PR #1028. Measured before and after against the real forge body.
